question: Will the 12-month change in U.S. average hourly earnings of all private employees (BLS, seasonally adjusted; computed from the level) for August 2025 (the latest monthly reading dated on or before 2025-08-14) be at least 3.70% and below 4.10%?

rule.threshold_basis: rounded lower and upper quartiles of historical moves over the same distance

source: Source: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics
